source.usage: Amplitude, unique users of Service_Clicked, 2 Sep to 2 Oct 2026

types.standalone: One task, one entity, one sitting. Named with a verb and the one thing. No badge; the owner shows beside the name.
types.bundle: The same job done for many items at once, by DubaiNow. Named with a verb and the whole set, with a count line. Badge: All at once.
types.journey: A life goal across many entities over weeks or months. Named with a verb and the goal, with a scale line. Badge: Start to finish.

kinds.thing: One of the resident's things (vehicles, documents, properties). A page, not a service; named Your ...
kinds.option: A choice inside a service, such as a charity inside Donate to a registered charity.

naming: Describe the task, not the technology.
Leave out entity names; the owner is shown beside the name. Providers a resident holds an account with (du, e&, Salik, nol, ENOC) are named.
Keep the name when the owner or system changes.
No branding or marketing words, and never Journey or Bundle in a name.
Sentence case, under 60 characters, no full stop.
Your for things they have, a for new things.
Local words in brackets only if residents say them: Register your tenancy contract (Ejari).
When a bundle and a standalone give the same result, the standalone takes the narrower name.
Arabic is written, not translated, and a native editor signs off both.
rules.ids: Ids are verb-first and leave out the entity, so they survive a change of owner (parking moved from RTA to Parkin in 2024).
